newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting light to moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 1,800 slaughter steers and 500 heifers; 92,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 23,700 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.
Wk to date - 92,200 Week Ago - 94,400 Year Ago - 75,200
